questions.q: How many patients discontinued the SJ-2041 Phase III trial?
questions.doc: Clinical Site List and Enrolment Status
questions.answer: 92 patients, 7.4% of the 1,240 randomised (as of 30 September 2026).

questions.q: What RPO and RTO does the new NimbusOps DR design target?
questions.doc: Design Doc – NimbusOps Multi-Region Active-Passive DR
questions.evidence: Design targets: RPO of 5 minutes and RTO of 30 minutes.
questions.answer: RPO 5 minutes and RTO 30 minutes, inside the contractual 15 minutes / 1 hour.
